free_parameters.name: nsize
free_parameters.why: posit width; the guard is checked before nsize is used, so any valid width works

free_parameters.name: es
free_parameters.why: posit exponent size; only validated after the rounding guard

free_parameters.name: scale
free_parameters.why: posit scale factor; only used after the rounding guard

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: posit_quantize requires float32 and the guard is before any tensor math

free_parameters.name: x_values
free_parameters.why: small CPU tensor; the guard never reads x

execution.entry_reason: The official entry quantize() at api.py::quantize never forwards rounding; its call chain (search_channels -> posit_quantize) always uses the default rounding='nearest', so the invalid-rounding guard cannot be reached through it. Calling posit_quantize (last call-chain element) directly is required to exercise the guard.
